entries.32db084add04f8c5: This is a single business conducted by the company and its three consolidated subsidiaries (Dengyosha Kōji Co., Ltd., Eco Advance Co., Ltd. and DMW India). In addition to wind and hydraulic machinery such as pumps, blowers and valves, it manufactures and sells energy recovery devices, wastewater and waste treatment equipment, and switchboards and electrical instrumentation and control equipment, and handles installation work through to maintenance and inspection. The Mishima Works in Mishima City, Shizuoka Prefecture, is the main manufacturing base, and DMW India has a factory in Pune, India. All products are made to order, and the number of consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 was 556. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
